headline: DO: call Chesley C. tonight — the re-offer on 195 Lake View is now 29 hours unanswered, a new agent walked the house at 9:00 this morning, and the other side reached your seller directly today. · WATCH: the Monday closing in Athens is at risk — the lender says the file has sat in final since morning and the borrower has slow-walked docs.

notes: Nothing BLOCKED today — but five routines never fired at all: The Daily (no letter, 2nd time this week), inbox triage, Money Pulse, last night's Deep Dive, and the ISA evening briefing (3rd day missing). The Delta ran twice and is the only advisor surface you got.

The Delta retracted two of its own claims at 3:20p — the Friday inspection IS on your calendar, and the milestone engine HAS been running. Both were absences asserted without checking the source. Correct behavior, worth knowing the board self-corrects.

Real gap found: 1709 Fieldstone went live in MLS ~2 days early and no routine saw it, because the go-live signal only ever existed in a text relay and a vendor email. The engine reads Gmail threads. Blind channel, not a broken engine.

callBlock.why: 🔥 THE ONE THING and it is past due. The conditional re-offer landed 12:16 PM yesterday and is 29 hours unanswered — past your own 24-hour bar. Two things changed today: a brand-new buyer agent toured the house at 9:00 this morning (showing #10), and the other side's agent reached your seller directly at 11:08 about the crawl space. When the other side is talking to your client and your client has no answer from you, you are no longer running the negotiation. Call tonight

⏰ LAST NIGHT BEFORE THE INSPECTION. Her buyer answered 'interested: Yes' in writing on 5167 Lake Crest and nobody has called her in three days. The physical inspection is TOMORROW 9:00 AM — the one window where this deal can die. A written backup costs nothing and quietly strengthens you on every repair ask that comes out of tomorrow. A second backup candidate is open on the same listing

🆕 4:16 PM TODAY — the FIRST feedback ever on 821 Martinwood, and it is a price objection: not interested, 'too high,' house rated 3 of 5. That also means a showing happened Monday 7/20 that no board was tracking. He is on the phone anyway about tomorrow's Lake Crest inspection and the backup-offer news — one call covers the inspection, the backup, and the first real data point on Martinwood

🆕 Emailed you at 4:25 PM today asking what the lowest is that they'd take on an Alabaster house, and you answered 'I will see what I can find out.' A buyer who asks that question is a buyer with a number in mind. Nothing was tracking this before today — call the listing side, then call him back with something

🆕 You put a $375K ceiling in front of him at 4:24 PM and he answered 'Ok.' He now has your research and your number, and you still do not know whether the Orange Beach property is even listed. Giving a number raises the stakes — it does not lower them. Close the loop before he shops it

The listing agent on one of his four target houses asked for a decision and there is a 1031 identification clock running on money that MUST be spent. Asked to tour by text and again by voicemail; nothing has gone back, day 10. You also hold 11 verified-yours seller names in his target ZIP — the same call can source a listing

His PCB condo has its first showing in weeks — Saturday 9:30 AM, buyer agent out of the Laguna Beach side. 123 days on market with zero activity before this. Have the showing conversation BEFORE the price-or-reposition conversation; the framing changes completely when there's a buyer in the door Saturday. Still no email on file, capture it on the phone

She asked to see 198 Rena 'this weekend' and you said yes — three weekends have now passed and a fourth is two days out. A call-in buyer on your OWN listing is a double-end, and there is no email on file, so the phone is the only channel that exists

listings.note: Three things moved today and none of them were your answer. (1) The new agent's 9:00 AM showing happened — showing #10, no read back yet. (2) At 11:08 AM the buyer side reached your seller DIRECTLY about the crawl space and got the question answered without you. (3) The conditional re-offer from 12:16 PM yesterday is still sitting there at 29 hours, past your own 24-hour bar. ⚠️ The weak spot is unchanged: the buyers' own home is NOT under contract — it goes live Monday — so the 48-hour break clause is the only thing that makes this workable, and that clause conversation is now 9 days old. Seller answers first, buyer side second. Sunday 7/19's showing has been re-asked SIX times with nothing back. ⚠️ THREE unsent drafts are stacked to this seller in Gmail, one of them a counter on the offer that was rescinded 7/16 — do not bulk-approve, the premise is dead

Full list, executed 7/21. Physical inspection CONFIRMED tomorrow Fri 7/24 9:00 AM — you locked it on your own calendar 7/21, and the utilities-prep text went out. That is the contingency window and it opens in 15 hours. ⚠️ Two items still open: (1) the moved-up close date is NOT agreed — the contract still reads the original date and only the lender has replied; (2) the written 'interested: Yes' backup buyer has now gone THREE days uncalled, and tonight is the last night the ask is free. Three buyers wanted this house inside 32 hours

listings.status: ✅ ACTIVE — went live today (was Coming Soon)
listings.note: 🆕 IT IS LIVE. Went ACTIVE in the MLS roughly two days early — verified on two sources today: your seller texting 'we're on the market now' at 10:53 AM and an outside MLS feed at 12:05 PM. No routine caught it, because the go-live signal never touched email. 🔴 The list price is STILL unreadable by any routine and must not be quoted anywhere — it lives in a signed PDF nothing in the fleet parses. The launch draft has now sat unsent 29+ hours and the reason it was being held has expired. Photos, copy and a go-live push are the work, and the house is already taking traffic

🆕 2:46 PM TODAY — the lender says the file has been 'in for final since this morning, hasn't been picked up,' can't close Monday, and the borrower has slow-walked docs. The deadline hour is still unknown (nobody has confirmed whether it's Pacific or Eastern). ⚠️ Also corrected today: the 7/17 'clear to close' was a brokerage commission document, NOT a lender clear-to-close — this deal was never lender-cleared. Institutional seller, so there is no seller to call; the move is on the lender and the closing coordinator, tonight

listings.status: Clear to Close — but still taking showings
listings.note: 🆕 Two new signals today. At 2:27 PM the Sunday 7/19 backup showing finally answered: not interested, but priced 'JUST RIGHT' — the buyer wanted Oak Mountain Intermediate schools, updates and a bigger backyard. That is a location-and-condition loss, not a price loss. Then at 5:31 PM a SECOND showing got confirmed for tomorrow Fri 7/24 11:15 AM. A house that is clear-to-close should not be booking showings — either that's genuine backup interest worth having, or the MLS status is stale and agents are touring a sold house. Worth two minutes to check. Close date 7/29. ⚠️ FHA appraisal ordered is still unverified at day 16

🆕 4:16 PM TODAY — the first feedback this listing has ever produced, and it reveals a showing on Monday 7/20 10:45 AM that no board was tracking. The read: not interested, price 'TOO HIGH,' overall listing rated 3 of 5, experience 'good.' One data point is not a pricing verdict, but it is the only data point this house has, and it says the number. Fold it into tomorrow's Sulman call alongside the Lake Crest inspection

SHOWING CONFIRMED Sat 7/25 9:30 AM — first activity in weeks after 123 days on market. Buyer agent out of the Laguna Beach side. Last feedback 7/1 was 'not interested' and the 7/10 showing was never confirmed. PCB market 7/16: 68 sold vs 218 new listings. Call Jeff with the showing news BEFORE the price conversation, then nudge for feedback Saturday afternoon — PCB feedback on this listing has never come back unasked. Still no email on file

Live offer via a buyer agent at ARC Realty with a buyer credit and a concession. Seth's question about what the concession covers is still open and the corrected net sheet still has not gone out — eight days now. Price already validated 'just right.' The 7/15 showing still owes a read, 8 days out. A week of silence on an open offer is how offers go cold

The traffic king — three showings in the window and three reads still outstanding. Of the answered reads, three point AWAY from price (location, location, still-deciding) and only the oldest said 'too high.' The 7/14 buyer 'really liked it,' toured in pouring rain and flagged PUDDLING in the patio area, still deciding which part of Birmingham he wants. Two cheap moves: check the patio grading and downspout before the next rain showing, and hold the number while the traffic holds

The objection on record is the floor plan, not the number — 7/12: 'She LOVED the yard and lot,' interior 'too compartmentalized.' Pivot the photos and copy to the lot and outdoor living. Hot inbound buyer Kimberly W. is still waiting on a showing time, three weekends on. 66 DOM. Your own 'Sold by Strategy' feedback letter went to the Carrolls — that thread is warm, use it

Signed and funded 7/21. Terminal. The damp-carpet scare closed itself in 81 minutes — the sellers had already spot-cleaned, no leak, no claim. Post-close sequence armed: Day-1 review-ask call, Day-30 check-in, Day-90 referral. One open courtesy item: the other office still owes the sellers the deed for utilities

🔥 FOUR people raised a hand on the campaign today — each already got an in-thread reply with the landing page and a private-showing offer, and each one is now a DM you owe before Saturday's go-live. That is real pre-launch demand on your own SPG listing, plus the buyer who registered 7/22 asking to learn more. Work it now; a Coming Soon window is the cheapest demand you will ever build

A Bessemer file shows PENDING with you as listing agent and the folder has ZERO messages behind it. A 90-day address search and 120 days of Bessemer mail found nothing, so seller, price and close date are all UNVERIFIED and no milestone has ever fired. Both were handled by hand — not by the machine, because Money Pulse never ran today and the accounting bank feed is frozen a 5th day. That is two straight days with zero automated eyes on cash. Also still open: the two SIM changes on your 2FA line from 7/21 are unconfirmed as yours, and the vendor subscription is day 12 on an expired card with the domain and website still exposed. 90 seconds in the bank app with your own eyes is tonight's whole ask.
